purpose: Handle moderation; teach 名無し/適切/削除/アプリケーション/上記/記述/つぶやき/特許

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 名無しの投稿で、荒らしが増えてきた。
lines.en: Anonymous posts have brought more trolling.
lines.style: frustrated dev reporting a problem, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 不適切なものは、すぐ削除しよう。
lines.en: Let’s delete the inappropriate ones right away.
lines.style: decisive lead taking action, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: アプリケーションに通報ボタンを追加したよ。
lines.en: I added a report button to the application.
lines.style: proactive dev showing his fix, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いいね。上記のルールを画面に表示しよう。
lines.en: Good. Let’s display the above rules on screen.
lines.style: lead refining the approach, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 規約に、禁止事項を記述しておくね。
lines.en: I’ll describe the prohibitions in the terms.
lines.style: diligent dev handling the policy, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: つぶやき機能は人気だけど、管理が大変だ。
lines.en: The murmur feature’s popular, but moderation is tough.
lines.style: lead weighing the tradeoff, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: この通報の仕組み、特許になりそうな発想だね。
lines.style: impressed dev praising the idea, tone holding steady through the whole line
